newsitem.title: USA: Centura names Sewell chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Centura names Sewell chairman, CEO.

text.p: Centura Banks Inc president and chief operating officer Cecil Sewell will succeed Robert Mauldin as chairman and chief executive officer, the financial services company said Wednesday.
Mauldin, 62, is retiring February 1. He became chairman and CEO in January 1993. Though retired, he will serve as Centura's chairman of the board's executive committee, the company said.
Sewell, 50, was named president and COO in October 1993.
The company said Sewell plans no major changes in Centura's strategies and will wait until after the February board meeting to announce any organizational changes.
Centura, with assets of $6.3 billion, provides banking, investment, insurance and trust services throughout North Carolina.
